title: AUDUSD H1 — EA log + quick read on the move
author: Hot-Mixture109
selftext:
Sharing this one mostly for the record, since it’s a clean example of the kind of range the EA is built to catch.
What happened on the chart:
AUDUSD ran hard off the 30 Jul low near 0.6950, pushing almost 500 pips to a high just above 0.7040 before stalling. That’s a strong impulsive leg — the kind of move that usually needs a pullback or consolidation before it can continue.
The EA took a long entry around 0.70260 during the uptrend, then a second long around 0.70025 after price pulled back into that zone — basically buying the retracement instead of chasing the top. Both entries lined up with areas that had acted as support/resistance earlier in the session, which is the core logic: react to levels the market has already respected, not to a single breakout candle.
Price has since rallied back up toward 0.70367, which lines up almost exactly with the prior swing high (dotted line on the chart). That’s a logical spot for the move to pause — it’s the same level that rejected price before, so it makes sense buyers and sellers are fighting it out there again.
